title: Check Open stunnel Connections After Remote Access to the Computer
summary: After remotely accessing the OptiSweep computer, verify that the Open stunnel connections view shows exactly 3 connections with labels AI01, AI02, and SortationChat (via File -> connections).
when_to_use: Use when you have remotely accessed the OptiSweep computer and need to confirm the expected Open stunnel secure connections are present and correctly labeled.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the remote check and confirm the Open stunnel connections list contains exactly 3 entries labeled AI01, AI02, and SortationChat.
access_or_tools_needed: Remote access to the computer (per training segment evidence).
Menu access within the stunnel view: File -> connections.

access_required: Remote access to the OptiSweep computer (as referenced in the source segment).
system_preconditions: Open stunnel view/application is available to open and navigate to File -> connections.

visual_references.description: Training frame showing the Open stunnel view and OCR text indicating File -> connections and expected 3 connections labeled AI01, AI02, SortationChat.

steps.title: Remotely access the computer
steps.purpose: Establish the remote session needed to view the Open stunnel connections interface.
steps.instruction: Using your remote access method to the computer (as referenced in the source segment), connect to the OptiSweep computer.
steps.expected_result: You are successfully connected to the computer and can open the Open stunnel view.
steps.healthy_condition: Remote session is active and the Open stunnel application/view can be opened.
steps.failure_condition: Remote access cannot be established or you cannot reach the Open stunnel view.

actions.label: Remote into the computer
actions.exact_action: I can remote into the computer.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot remotely access the computer, stop and escalate for remote access troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: "I can remote into the computer."

steps.title: Open the stunnel-related application/view
steps.purpose: Reach the Open stunnel interface where connections are listed.
steps.instruction: Open the Open stunnel view/application referenced in the source frame.
steps.expected_result: The Open stunnel view is open and ready for navigation to the connections list.
steps.healthy_condition: Open stunnel view is visible (the interface referenced by the source OCR).
steps.failure_condition: Open stunnel view cannot be opened or is not accessible in the remote session.
stop_or_escalate_if: If Open stunnel cannot be opened, stop and escalate for application access/troubleshooting.

steps.title: Navigate to File -> connections in the stunnel view
steps.purpose: Display the connections list that should contain exactly 3 connections.
steps.instruction: In the Open stunnel view, use the menu path indicated by the source OCR: Under file -> click connections.
steps.healthy_condition: A connections list is visible in the Open stunnel view after selecting File -> connections.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting File -> connections does not display a connections list.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the connections list does not open, stop and escalate for UI navigation/application troubleshooting.

steps.title: Confirm the connections list shows 3 connections
steps.purpose: Validate the expected number of stunnel connections is present.
steps.instruction: In the connections list, confirm it shows exactly 3 connections.
steps.healthy_condition: Exactly 3 connection entries are present in the Open stunnel connections view.
steps.failure_condition: The connections list shows a count other than 3.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the connections view does not show 3 connections, stop and escalate for further troubleshooting.

steps.title: Verify connection labels are AI01, AI02, and SortationChat
steps.purpose: Validate that the expected stunnel connections are correctly identified by label.
steps.instruction: In the connections list, verify the connection labels include AI01, AI02, and SortationChat.
steps.expected_result: The connections list includes labels AI01, AI02, and SortationChat.
steps.healthy_condition: The three connection entries are labeled exactly AI01, AI02, and SortationChat.
steps.failure_condition: The labels do not include AI01, AI02, and SortationChat (or labels differ).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the labels do not include AI01, AI02, and SortationChat, stop and escalate for further troubleshooting.

success_criteria: Open stunnel connections view shows exactly 3 connections.
The three connections are labeled AI01, AI02, and SortationChat.
healthy_conditions: Connection labels match AI01, AI02, SortationChat.
failure_conditions: Connection labels do not include AI01, AI02, and SortationChat.
escalation_guidance: If the connections view does not show 3 connections or the labels do not include AI01, AI02, and SortationChat, stop and escalate for further troubleshooting (source provides only the stop/escalate trigger, not the next diagnostic actions).
